verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Langfuse has API endpoints, SDKs, and a Metrics API, but no interactive API reference with runnable examples (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI UI) is documented — in fact the probe for openapi.json/swagger.json returned 404 at all standard paths, indicating no discoverable interactive spec. Missing for 10: any documented interactive API explorer, 'try it out' console, or runnable example sandbox for the REST/API endpoints.
